title: Jacobian factorization in a chart: J(B∘Dψ(v)) = J(Dψ(v))·J(B∘ι_{T_{ψ(v)}M}) (Simon Ch. 2, 4.11; (7.1) of the supplied proof)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, M, W ⊆ ℝ^P, V ⊆ ℝ^m, ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^P, a continuous linear map B : ℝ^P → ℝ^P and v ∈ V. Assume (V, W, ψ) is a chart of M: V and W are open, ψ is C¹ on V and injective on V, ψ(V) = W ∩ M, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(z) = fderiv ℝ ψ z is injective for every z ∈ V. Let e_k := EuclideanSpace.single k 1 (k < m), T := span(tangentSpace M (ψ(v))) with the inner product of ℝ^P, and ι_T : T → ℝ^P the inclusion. Then √det[⟨B(Dψ(v)e_k), B(Dψ(v)e_l)⟩]_{k,l<m} = √det[⟨Dψ(v)e_k, Dψ(v)e_l⟩]_{k,l<m} · √det((B∘ι_T)*(B∘ι_T)), where the last determinant is that of an endomorphism of T, * is the adjoint for the inner products of T and ℝ^P, and √ is Real.sqrt.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M W : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P) (B : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (v : Euclid m), IsOpen V → IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ M → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → (∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)) → v ∈ V → Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin m => inner ℝ (B (fderiv ℝ ψ v (EuclideanSpace.single k 1))) (B (fderiv ℝ ψ v (EuclideanSpace.single l 1))))) = Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ v (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (fderiv ℝ ψ v (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))) * Real.sqrt (((B.comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M (ψ v))).subtypeL).adjoint ∘L (B.comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M (ψ v))).subtypeL)).det)
